official_definition: (Octa Ultimate Trigger: Send eight cards from the opposing deck to the Trash. If each of those cards' cost is lower than this Ultimate's, it's a hit.)

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Octa Ultimate Trigger] or [Octa Ultimate Trigger: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Octa Ultimate Trigger]", "give [Octa Ultimate Trigger]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
